Mild.Rule: After they put an enemy down, their next action is a speech about it. It does nothing
They will not Duck or go prone on purpose: they'd get dirty
Their hands shake: they cannot Aim while an enemy is within 6 inches
They will not Ask the voice
When they Ask the voice and get a good result, they are also **Announced**: they can't help telling everyone
They must deploy as close to the enemy as their deployment zone allows

Sillier.Rule: An enemy who puts them down gains **+1 XP**: everyone wants the story
When they Ask the voice, subtract 1 from the roll (a 1 stays a 1)
An enemy who wins a melee exchange against them is **Hyped**
When they go down, the opposing player moves one of their allies within 3 inches up to 2 inches
Their next Word must be one tier higher than the one they failed (a Legendary one stays Legendary)
They take no advance until they fulfil a Word. XP still counts, so a redeemed fighter catches up at once
